For the mobs in Dungeons, see MCD:Mob. For other uses, see Mob (disambiguation).

A mob (short for "mobile", "mobile entity", or "mobile object") is an AI-driven video game entity. They can be encountered in the forms of passive animals or hostile enemies, and can typically be harmed for drops. Summonable mobs cannot be harmed by heroes and are summoned from artifacts or as pets.

Minecraft Dungeons II shares many mobs with the original game and Minecraft Dungeons with behavioral differences, while also featuring many unique mobs.

List of mobs

Friendlies

Friendlies are non-hostile mobs including characters, companions, pets, and non-attackables.

Echo Golem

Characters

Characters are a category of passive mobs that can be interacted with to complete a quest.

Cartographer

Merchants

Merchants are passive mobs that can be traded with.

Blacksmith

Companions

Companions are a category of passive mobs that follow the player and function as allies in combat. They are summoned by certain talismans or artifacts.

Bee

Pets

Pets are a category of passive mobs that follow the player and are not attacked by mobs.

Non-attackable

Non-attackable mobs are a category of friendlies that cannot be attacked, functioning instead as background ambience or as objectives.

Bee
Trill

Enemies

Most enemies pursue and attack heroes on sight.

Undead

Zombie

Illagers

Evoker

Sifters

Sculkers

Mini-bosses

Mini-bosses are a category of mobs with health bars at the top of the screen.

Evoker

Bosses

Bosses are a category of uniquely powerful mobs.

Copper Monstrosity

Non-typical mobs

Summoned hazards

Mob-like

A non-attackable particle resembling a mob.

Trill

Cinematics and item descriptions

These mobs have only appeared in cinematics or been described in item descriptions.

Unused

Mobs that have appeared in files or development images, but are not in game.

Supplementary material

Mobs that have only appeared in promotional material.
